# Employees Dashboard

> A local People Analytics dashboard built with Next.js, React, and HeroUI v3. FastAPI serves the employee roster from SQLite.

## Project context

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Project instructions and HeroUI's generated React documentation index.
- [DESIGN.md](./DESIGN.md): The dashboard's glass theme and HeroUI's default theme reference.
- [README.md](./README.md): Setup, API flow, and tests.

## HeroUI documentation

- [Installed React documentation](./frontend/node_modules/@heroui/react/docs/llms.txt): Version-matched index available after installing frontend dependencies.
- [React documentation index](https://heroui.com/react/llms.txt): Hosted index for the current HeroUI release.
- [React components](https://heroui.com/react/llms-components.txt): Component anatomy, props, and examples.
- [React patterns](https://heroui.com/react/llms-patterns.txt): Composition and styling examples.
- [Theming with agents](https://heroui.com/en/docs/react/getting-started/theming-for-agents): Token, CSS layer, and theme customization guidance.
